item.content:encoded:
FAA tells US airlines to exercise caution in Saudi Arabia flights, citing safety risks Reuters | Updated: 12-10-2026 03:19 IST | Created: 12-10-2026 03:19 IST

SHARE

Key Takeaways AI Summary

Analyzing article...

The Federal Aviation Administration on Sunday told US airlines to exercise caution when flying to or over Saudi Arabia, citing safety threats tied to ongoing military activities and navigation system interference. The FAA Notice to Airmen, which lasts until December 10, follows strikes Saturday and Sunday on Riyadh's international airport. The attack on Saturday killed 13 people and wounded more than 300. "Threats could pose a potential risk to aircraft at all altitudes, including overflight, the arrival, and departure phases of flight," the FAA said.
